python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, os
n = 0
for line in open('/tmp/medgulf.b64', encoding='utf-8'):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    path, data = line.split('|', 1)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(base64.b64decode(data))
    n += 1
print(f"wrote {n} files")
PY
rm -f /tmp/medgulf.b64
